## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth is weak (4/11) and Technology shows broad weakness with multiple large-cap Tech names BELOW TREND (MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -19.68%) BELOW TREND). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +13.56%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing strength: GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare mixed but with pockets of strength: SYK (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +7.27%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.76% | 1M: -20.69%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND with PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) as a short-term outlier. Consumer Discretionary soft with TSLA (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -11.02%) BELOW TREND and AMZN (1W: +3.26% | 1M: -12.41%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL; GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND; ASML (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors). Style: Cyclical/Value tilt given Energy and Industrials leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND; DOW (1W: -6.74% | 1M: +6.95%) TREND EXHAUSTION; INTC (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -19.68%) BELOW TREND; ETN (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +8.39%) TREND EXHAUSTION; COF (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology and select Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: several names (e.g., PYPL, AMZN, EL) show 1W strength but 1M weakness — tactical setups, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak: NVDA (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +3.63%) ABOVE TREND and AAPL (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND are bright spots, while MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND and a swath of names (ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -19.68%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -11.76% | 1M: -20.69%) BELOW TREND) show material downside — Sector breadth: Technology: 4/24 positive. Watch for narrow leadership risk.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak overall with isolated moves: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -5.89%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND, while PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) is a short-term momentum name — Sector breadth: Financials: 4/20 positive. Style: mixed, but biased away from broad Financial leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive tone with select strength: SYK (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +7.27%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND shows dispersion — Sector breadth: Healthcare: 8/17 positive. Watch drug approvals/news-driven movers.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and high-quality Industrials and select Healthcare names (OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND; SYK (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +7.27%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to high-beta Tech names showing broad breakdown (MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND) and weak Financials like COF (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical preferred over Growth in this RISK-OFF backdrop, but major divergences advise selectivity.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — follow takeover flow; AMAT (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +17.32%) ABOVE TREND — semiconductor capex play; OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND — momentum. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +12.11%; Energy: 8/10 positive) and Industrials (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +7.06%; Industrials: 10/15 positive). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -9.89%; Technology: 4/24 positive) and Financials (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -4.66%; Financials: 4/20 positive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +3.63%) ABOVE TREND — reclaiming recent swing highs would confirm further upside. AAPL (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND — hold near recent 1M support to keep trend intact. MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim short-term support would signal more downside. OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND — watch for continuation or quick mean-reversion after sharp move.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (+80): takeover chatter; price shows 1W surge but 1M decline — confirming short-term interest, divergent vs longer-term (PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL). AMAT (+60): strong semi outlook and price ABOVE TREND (AMAT (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +17.32%) ABOVE TREND) — sentiment confirmed. CVX (+60): deal/negotiation headlines and price ABOVE TREND (CVX (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND) — sentiment confirmed. WMT (+80): upbeat earnings/buyback headline but price showing TREND EXHAUSTION (WMT (1W: -6.03% | 1M: +6.77%) TREND EXHAUSTION) — divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-80): legal ruling; price BELOW TREND (TSLA (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -11.02%) BELOW TREND) — sentiment confirmed. IBM (-60): negative headline and heavy price action BELOW TREND (IBM (1W: -14.88% | 1M: -23.77%) BELOW TREND) — confirmed weakness. UNH (-55): weaker guidance headlines and price BELOW TREND (UNH (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND) — confirmed. DE (-50) and XOM (-50) show negative headlines but remain ABOVE TREND (DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +13.56%) ABOVE TREND) — headline/price divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Cyclical/Value tilt given Energy and Industrials leadership. OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +17.32%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across timeframes (multiple large caps with 1W up but 1M down) and headline-driven shocks (TSLA, IBM) that could keep volatility elevated.
